race.title: Prior Park Service Station Clonmel Handicap Chase (0-100)
race.verdict: Sent off favourite returning over fences, ONEFORTHEDITCH was undone by an awkward landing 2 out when finishing mid-field at Galway a month ago, so she is well worth another chance off her significantly lower chase mark. She gets the vote ahead of Courtbrack Boy who made an encouraging chasing debut, while Stily could also be in the mix. ONEFORTHEDITCH (IRE) COURTBRACK BOY (IRE) STILY (FR)
